data.query: Beyond Snack revenue expenses loss FY financials crore
data.answer: Beyond Snack reported a 55% surge in revenue to Rs 53 crore in FY25, up from Rs 34.2 crore in FY24, according to its financial statements sourced from the Registrar of Companies (RoC). The company's total expenses rose sharply by 82% to Rs 73.8 crore in FY25, from Rs 40.5 crore in FY24. The largest cost component, cost of goods sold, increased by 58% to Rs 32.9 crore in FY25, compared to Rs 20.9 crore in FY24. Employee benefit expenses nearly doubled to Rs 9.6 crore from Rs 5 crore in FY24. The company reported a net loss of Rs 20.9 crore in FY25, marking a 3.3X increase from Rs 6.3 crore in FY24.

results.content: Dear Shareholders, I am pleased to report a strong finish to FY 2025-26. The Company closed the year with record revenue of ` 1,725 Crore and a meaningful recovery in profitability that validates the operational choices we have been making over the past several quarters. The recovery is most visible in the margin trajectory. Gross margin expanded to 28.8%, up 160 basis points year on year, driven by improved price rationalisation, cost optimisation and procurement efficiencies. EBITDA rose 68% to ` 81.8 Crore, with margins moving from 2.9% to 4.7%. The Company returned to a profit after tax of ` 9.7 Crore against a loss of ` 34.3 Crore in FY 2024-25, and free cash flow turned decisively positive at ` 35.3 Crore.
